title: Tech Note: 4D Gantt Chart Component
author: Atanas Atanassov, Technical Services Team Member, 4D Inc.
featured_technology: 4D SVG Component (120 commands) introduced in 4D v11 SQL Release 3
Interactive SVG Gantt chart built from SVG_New_rect/line/polygon/text and gradients
SVG_Export_to_picture and DOM XML manipulation of the SVG structure
Gantt Chart Wizard driven by field mapping to a 4D table

historical_commentary.text: This note demonstrates building an interactive Gantt chart by hand-driving the 4D SVG Component's low-level drawing commands (rectangles, polygons, lines, gradients) and manipulating the resulting SVG/XML tree in response to mouse clicks. The 4D SVG Component itself was an add-on around at the time and its command-by-command approach to vector graphics has been largely superseded by 4D's built-in picture/vector capabilities and, for genuine business charting/reporting needs, by 4D View Pro (spreadsheet/chart component, ~v17-18) which natively supports Gantt-style timeline visualizations without hand-coded SVG. The specific component and wizard shown here would not be how a developer would build this feature in a current 4D project.
related_updates: 4D View Pro (4D v17-18+) provides native spreadsheet/charting capability that can build Gantt-style visualizations without manual SVG coding
4D's native picture object and CSS-based styling reduce the need for hand-built SVG DOM manipulation for many graphic tasks
Project mode (4D v17+, 2018) replaced the binary component packaging used to distribute this Gantt Chart component
